topic.title: Docker
topic.description: Containers, images, logs, networks, volumes and Docker Compose operations

commands.name: docker ps

procedures.title: Investigate a container stuck in a restart loop
procedures.context: The api container shows 'Restarting (1)' in docker ps.
procedures.goal: Find the exit reason and whether it was an OOM kill.

steps.output:
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE      STATUS                         NAMES
9a8b7c6d5e4f  app:2.4.1  Restarting (137) 8 seconds ago   api

output_notes.meaning: Exit code 137 on each restart.
output_notes.anomaly: 137: killed by SIGKILL, often the memory limit.

steps.interpretation: It keeps restarting with code 137; check whether it is an OOM kill.

steps.output:
INFO  loading 2.1M records into cache
Killed
steps.interpretation: 'Killed' with no error from the app usually means the kernel killed it.
137 true: raise the memory limit or fix the leak; 1 false: application error in the logs.

output_notes.meaning: OOMKilled flag.
output_notes.anomaly: true: the memory limit was hit.
